clues: This city in Ghana is where main roads from four towns cross. The roads link it to Sunyani, Kumasi, Wa, and Tamale.
Rain here does not come just once a year. This land has a tropical savanna climate, with two wet seasons and then a dry season.
This city was founded in 1740. That year marks the start of its story as a town of the Bono state.
Farmers bring their crops to a huge open-air market here. It is one of the largest markets in all of West Africa.
A vote in 2018 made new regions in Ghana. This city was picked as the capital of the Bono East Region.
